# Heatmap (`heatmap`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs.js from schema.json. Edit the schema, then run `npm run docs`. -->

A grid of one measure across two dimensions, shaded from light (low) to dark (high), with empty cells kept visible as gaps.

**Use when:** One measure cross-tabbed by two dimensions: margin by manufacturer and quarter, orders by branch and item class, revenue by rep and KPA. Missing cells stay visible as gaps.

**Don't use when:** There is only one dimension (use bar_chart), the columns are a long time series for a few rows (use line_chart), or the user needs records with mixed fields (use table).

**Sizes:** M, L, full (default)

## Fields

Fields from `id` to `note` are shared by every widget.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"heatmap"` | yes | Always "heatmap". |
| `id` | string | yes | Unique id within the dashboard: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens, e.g. "open-ar". |
| `title` | string | yes | What the widget shows, in sentence case with no trailing period, e.g. "Revenue by rep, Q3 2026". |
| `subtitle` | string |  | Optional one line of context under the title: scope, filter, or unit. |
| `size` | `"M"` \| `"L"` \| `"full"` |  | Width on the 12-column grid (S = 3, M = 6, L = 9, full = 12). Allowed: M, L, full. Default: `"full"`. |
| `note` | string |  | Optional footnote: caveats, definitions, or why data is missing. |
| `row_labels` | list of string | yes | Labels down the left side, in display order, e.g. manufacturers sorted by revenue. |
| `column_labels` | list of string | yes | Labels across the top, in display order. Keep periods in time order, oldest first. |
| `values` | list of list of number or null | yes | One list per row label, each with one raw number per column label: values[row][column]. Use null for a missing or withheld cell, never 0. |
| `format` | `"number"` \| `"integer"` \| `"currency"` \| `"percent"` |  | How cell values are displayed. percent expects fractions: 0.124 shows as 12.4%. Default: `"number"`. |
| `row_header` | string |  | Header above the row labels, e.g. "Manufacturer". |
| `show_values` | boolean |  | Print the value in each cell. Turn off only for large grids where the shading alone tells the story. Default: `true`. |

## Example

```json
{
  "type": "heatmap",
  "id": "margin-by-mfr-quarter",
  "title": "Gross margin by manufacturer and quarter",
  "subtitle": "Commercial segment, last 5 quarters",
  "size": "full",
  "format": "percent",
  "row_header": "Manufacturer",
  "row_labels": ["Summit Computing", "Acme Networks", "Ridgeline Storage", "Bluepeak AV", "Harbor Security"],
  "column_labels": ["Q3 2025", "Q4 2025", "Q1 2026", "Q2 2026", "Q3 2026"],
  "values": [
    [0.094, 0.101, null, 0.112, 0.118],
    [0.142, 0.138, 0.151, 0.147, 0.156],
    [0.071, 0.076, null, 0.083, 0.088],
    [0.188, 0.176, 0.192, 0.201, 0.197],
    [0.122, null, null, 0.131, 0.129]
  ],
  "note": "Q1 2026 values are withheld for manufacturers under cost restatement."
}
```

## Checks beyond the schema

- Error when values doesn't have one row per row label, or a row doesn't have one value per column label.
- Error when two row labels or two column labels are the same.
- Warns when percent values look like whole numbers (45 instead of 0.45).
- Warns when every cell is null.
- Warns when more than 12 columns are shown at a size smaller than full.
